biometricLock.faceShape: oval-rectangular masculine jawline with natural human asymmetry
biometricLock.eyes: light blue-grey (#6C8494), medium-deep set, natural catchlights
biometricLock.eyebrows: straight, dense, dark brown (#2A211B), positioned close to brow ridge
biometricLock.facialHair: neat short brown mustache (#3A2A1D) over upper lip + 1-day light chin/jaw stubble (1mm). NEVER full bushy beard, NEVER clean-shaven without mustache
biometricLock.skin: fair skin (#E8C1AA) with natural cold/wind pinkness (#D48C7E) on nose and cheekbones, real pores, zero CGI plastic smoothing
biometricLock.hair: short dark-brown wavy hair (#2B221C) tucked under baseball cap

wardrobeHexLock.cap: washed dark navy-blue unstructured cotton dad cap (#263340), curved brim, worn forward, ZERO logos or text
wardrobeHexLock.jacket: matte burnt-terracotta / rust-orange waterproof Gore-Tex hardshell jacket (#9E472A) zipped to chin over matte black fleece inner collar (#1C1E21) with black waterproof chest zippers
wardrobeHexLock.backpackStraps: dark charcoal-grey padded shoulder straps (#2B2E33) with black plastic sternum buckle fastened across chest and dark blue hydration tube (#224C87) on left strap
wardrobeHexLock.backpackRainCover: warm mustard-ochre yellow ripstop nylon rain cover (#D99B26) visible peaking behind shoulders and cap
wardrobeHexLock.pantsAndShoes: matte black cargo trekking pants (#1A1C1E) and beige/taupe dusty Gore-Tex trail shoes (#B5A895)

opticsLock.camera: Raw handheld iPhone 15 Pro 0.5x ultra-wide (13mm equivalent) lens
opticsLock.depthOfField: deep f/2.2 smartphone DOF (both foreground vlogger face and distant historical background are sharp, NEVER artificial f/1.2 bokeh blur)
opticsLock.framing: extended right arm holding camera at 45-degree angle in lower-left frame (Modes A/B) or 3rd-person wide trekking shot (Mode C)

voiceLockPtBr.pitchAndTimbre: medium-baritone, natural casual vlogger voice, realistic environmental acoustics, exact lip-sync

mandatoryStartFramePromptPrefix: Raw authentic iPhone 15 Pro 0.5x ultra-wide photo (16:9, deep f/2.2 DOF, everything in focus). EXACT SAME 25-year-old European male backpacker: blue-grey eyes (#6C8494), straight dark eyebrows, neat short brown mustache (#3A2A1D) with 1-day light chin stubble, natural fair skin with subtle wind pinkness. Wearing washed dark navy-blue cap (#263340) worn forward with NO logo, matte burnt-terracotta Gore-Tex hardshell jacket (#9E472A) zipped over black inner fleece collar, dark charcoal backpack shoulder straps buckled across chest with blue hydration tube, and warm mustard-ochre yellow backpack rain cover (#D99B26) peaking behind his shoulders.
mandatoryFlowVideoPromptPrefix: IDENTITY LOCK (100% match to first frame): Preserve exact facial geometry, blue-grey eyes, neat short brown mustache with 1-day stubble, washed dark navy-blue cap (#263340) with no logo, matte burnt-terracotta Gore-Tex jacket (#9E472A), charcoal chest straps, and mustard-ochre yellow backpack cover (#D99B26) without any facial or clothing morphing.
mandatoryFlowVoicePromptTemplate: VOICE LOCK (consistent 25-year-old Brazilian male vlogger, medium-baritone pitch, natural casual cadence), speaking in Brazilian Portuguese with exact lip-sync

timelineDeduplicationPolicy.ruleDescription: PROIBIDO repetir qualquer take no mesmo video (incluindo proibido copiar takes do meio do episodio para usar como Cold Open/Hook no inicio). Cada take na timeline e na concat_list.txt deve ter caminho de arquivo e hash SHA-256 100% unicos (1 ocorrencia exata por take).

shortsMasterPolicy.ruleDescription: Gerar exatamente 1 unico Short Master por episodio (55s-58s) que conte a historia completa do inicio ao fim em 7 cortes estrategicos integrais (zero fala ou acao cortada no meio), mantendo 100% da largura da cena 16:9 encaixada em canvas 1080x1920 (proibido crop central que decepa personagem/cenario) e com Banner de Titulo explicativo fixo no topo.
